create.name: Susie Harrington
create.bio:
Susie Harrington is an insight meditation teacher based in Moab, Utah, and the guiding teacher of Desert Dharma, which brings Buddhist meditation groups and retreats to communities across Utah, western Colorado and the wider Southwest. She has practised in the insight tradition since 1989 and began teaching in 2005 at the invitation of three senior teachers, Jack Kornfield, Joseph Goldstein and Guy Armstrong. Other teachers she has learned from include Adyashanti and Tsoknyi Rinpoche, and she continues to explore the Diamond Approach of A. H. Almaas.

Before teaching full time she spent three decades working outdoors as a river guide, mountain guide and backcountry ranger, and the natural world sits at the centre of her teaching. Many of her retreats are held largely outside, in canyon country, the mountains of New Mexico or by the ocean, using the land and the elements as companions in practice. Her teaching is strongly rooted in the body and pays close attention to mindful speech, inquiry and daily life, and she mentors students through a two-year programme in everyday practice. She also teaches at insight centres across North America, including the Insight Meditation Society's online nature sangha and month-long silent retreats.

courses.title: Bowing to Gaia: Dancing with the Aliveness of All Beings
courses.description: A seven-day silent retreat on Hawaii's Big Island with Susie and Erin Selover, exploring interdependence with the natural world through the body and the elements. Days combine sitting and walking practice, talks, movement, small-group inquiry and ritual.
